_about: DRAFT, unwired. The shape for the taunt director (docs/narrative/taunt-system.md) and the first batch of lines, all placeholders for Orb's edit (voice-lab/taunts-draft.csv). The ids match the CSV. Not in data/narrative yet: moving it there needs a schema in tools/schemas. Unsearched by Legal. Re-cut 2026-10-16 (night) to the Gemini-reviewed bibles (voice-bibles.md): the Cyborg's waiter lines are gone, the Empress's guard lines are 3v1 only, the rival keeps contractions and a ranking habit, 'Filth' is retired.

ladder._about: streak = taunts in a row by this fighter since an exchange began for either fighter. A rung is a range of streak values.
ladder.milestone_counts: standoff_count: taunts by both fighters since the last exchange, plus every taunt so far this stand-off
ladder.reset: An exchange (any hit landed, either way) ends the stand-off: streak and standoff_count return to zero, and the ladder is climbed afresh.

challenge._about: Orb's pick (2026-10-02): a far taunt is a challenge. The opponent answers by pressing attack during it, and both rush and meet in a clash. Ignored, the taunter keeps the line. Holding attack through the taunt takes off in a charge. Windows and meter gains belong to Game Design.

memory.cross_match: dialogue_seen.json per-line seen_count, as in dialogue-director.md section 3.3

selection.seed: match seed plus taunt index, own stream

lines.text: Come on. I've got all day.
Just stretching. Go ahead, take your time.
Still smiling. Still here.
That's two. I'm keeping count, you know.
Okay, now I'm enjoying this.
I'll keep going if you will.
We're really doing this, huh.
My feet hurt. Worth it.
At this point we're a landmark.
Somebody's going to blink. Not me.
That's ten. Not bad, for no punching.
Twenty-five. And nobody's even hurt.
Fifty! I'll be sore tomorrow. Worth it.
A hundred. Do I get a trophy, or do you?
You've got a lot of fight left. Good. I'd feel bad otherwise.
I'm behind. I'm having a great time.
Nice crater! You hit like a truck!
Away from the town, okay? Come on out here.
Your {part} looks sore. Want to call it?
I can still wave with this arm.
You went bigger. So will I.
Nice day for the sea. Nobody's hurt out here.
Say something mean. I've missed it.
Heavy crown? Let's see if it hits hard!
Don't tell me you're hungry. You're always hungry.
Fine. I'll come to you. Soon.
That one was good. Do another.
Keep your pity. I'll take your best.
Meet me in the middle?
Race you. Loser eats dirt.
Right here. Whenever you like.
Here we go!
Meeting you there!
On my way!
Shy? That's okay.
Nope? Next time, then.
Fine. I'll wait.
Here I come!
Coming in fast!
Brace yourself.
This one's heavy. Hold your ribs!
Over here!
Well?
Go on.
That was a nice crater.
Your guard's drooping.
I'm over here, by the way.
Show me something.
Do you want a turn?
Come and get it.
Friend.
Champ.
Start whenever you like. It won't help.
You're late. Typical third-rate habit.
Still standing there? Fifth place suits you.
That's two. I haven't moved either.
You're fifth. Behind the goons. Think about that.
Try something. Anything. I'll pretend to be surprised.
I've stood here so long my frames are fogging.
This is beneath us both. Mostly you.
A statue could've won this by now, clown.
You're last. Behind the furniture, and the floor.
Ten. You're exactly as predictable as I ranked you.
Twenty-five. Even the dead weight would've left.
Fifty. Tell nobody I stayed.
A hundred. I was never here.
You're not keeping up. Third-rate, as expected.
I'm behind. Notice how little it matters.
Nice hole. You dug it, you'll lie in it.
Look at the rubble. Sloppy work, amateur.
Your {part} looks like scrap now.
A scratch. I've had worse from amateurs.
You grew. Still third-rate, just bigger.
The sea. Fitting. You're shallow as a puddle.
Still think you'll fix this, clown?
Crooked hat. Barely top ten, Empress.
Keep drooling, scrap. I'm not a snack.
I don't come when called. I arrive.
Insult me better, amateur. That was weak.
Spare me. Your pity's cheap.
Meet me, if you can stomach it.
Try me. You'll learn something.
Come on, then. I won't be kind.
Finally.
Then meet me.
Don't blink.
You declined. Typical amateur.
Afraid. Just like I ranked you.
It was an offer. Smart of you.
Enough. Watch.
Now.
Hold your ground.
Brace.
Well?
Slow.
Again.
You're standing very still.
Nice crater.
Lucky swing.
I was told you'd be harder.
Try to impress me.
I've seen scrap fight better.
Amateur.
Fifth.
Petitioner, the queue ends here. Kneel.
Take your time, rat. We enjoy the wait.
Gahaha! Is that all the courage you've got?
Another taunt? We're counting. Each one costs a finger.
A full minute of staring. Scared, little rat?
How dull. We were promised violence!
Gahaha! Fine, we'll wait. We'll enjoy it.
We've run out of insults. Fetch us more, clown.
We'll declare this stand-off a province.
Our crown's gone out of fashion waiting. Hahaha!
That's ten, insect. Ten more and you bleed.
Twenty-five! Gahaha! We'll carve a monument here.
Fifty. We've stood here so long we've grown roots.
A hundred. We name this field after ourselves!
You're behind, rat. We're far ahead. Keep up!
We're behind? Hahaha! Nobody tell the empire.
A crater! We'll put a fountain in it.
Pretty ruins, rat. Mind your step!
Your {part}! What a gorgeous mess!
You hit our {part}? Gahaha! Bold, insect!
A new form of you? How inferior.
Guards, watch him. He's about to crawl.
Don't promise to fix us, petitioner.
Sulk louder, clown. We can't hear you from the throne.
Drool elsewhere, glutton. We're not on offer.
We don't go to petitioners. They come to us.
Rude! Say it again, slower, so we can laugh.
Pity us? We are the empire, rat.
Come, rat. We grant you an audience.
A duel? Gahaha! Come bleed for it.
The floor is yours. Try to hold it.
Granted!
The empire meets you!
Witness the empire!
No takers? Hahaha! Coward.
No takers. We keep the floor.
Declined. We'll remember your nerves.
The empire advances.
Hahaha! Here!
Stand aside. The empire arrives.
Out of our sky, insect!
Well, petitioner?
How dull.
Hahaha!
Your stance is sloppy.
We rather like the crater.
The guards are watching.
Try to be interesting.
We expected a better fight.
Come, impress us.
Petitioner.
Carry on, rat.
Mmm. Fresh protein, walking right up.
Sensors say you're packed with calories.
Stomach's growling. It's losing its temper.
Closer! I can't smell you from here.
Six minutes of waiting! That's calories I'll never see again!
Come on! My limiter's getting tired.
I've been starving for an hour. One snack. You.
Please! A bio-mech's gotta eat!
My stomach's started on the nearest wall.
Don't make me start on the furniture.
Ten! My stomach's counting too.
Twenty-five! I'm eating my own gears!
Fifty! I forgot what food tastes like.
A hundred! I'll name my appetite after you.
You're doing great! Keep not winning.
I'm behind? Just a light snack so far.
A crater! Perfect bowl for later.
Whole street's rubble. Good steel in there!
Your {part} looks tender. Real tender.
Not the {part}! That's my good meat!
A bigger portion! My stomach thanks you.
A harbour! Smells like seafood!
Ninety percent protein. I checked.
Skinny. Sharp. Probably crunchy.
All silk and bone. I'm not impressed.
Coming! Hold still, snack!
Feedback noted. Chewing it over.
Pity? I'd rather have protein.
Closer, snack! Let me smell you.
Come on! My sensors want a look!
Over here! The steel arm's waiting!
Chow time!
Coming in hungry!
Feed me!
No takers? Too bad. I'll starve.
Hiding? My sensors can smell you.
Fine. I'll chew on something else.
Here I come!
Chomp time!
Heavy load! Big appetite!
Heavy chassis! Move!
Hungry?
Closer.
Come on.
You smell nervous.
Nice crater.
My sensors are watching.
Crunchy or chewy?
Take your time. My stomach won't.
Got a spare rib?
Snack.
Protein.
